decisions.reason: The vertical mechanical-fit constraint does not change the battery-protection modes or cutoff values.
The board-orientation decision does not change the charge-status indicator, GPIO, or separate-LED requirement.
Although the surrounding discussion mentions battery access, the source decision does not change the existing requirement to include the NTC connection on J_BAT.
Requiring the board to fit vertically does not change battery temperature sensing through the J_BAT NTC.
The mechanical-fit decision does not alter boost-converter enable control, pull-down resistance, or powered-load behavior.
The source changes board fit and orientation only, leaving TVS-based ESD protection unchanged.
The vertical-fit constraint does not change the USB-C connector's data-line or sourceability requirements.
Board orientation and support mounting do not change the I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
